Publish.LongDescription:
# **Bridge the Language Gap**
### Version 1.0 Stable Release Is Here!
A fresh new look! The stable release includes a number of improvements, adds several major translation engines, dramatically boosts translation speed, and comes with a redesigned options interface.
## Description
From the first game to the second, localization for mods and assets has always depended heavily on authors and community contributors. Many interesting mods and assets remain untranslated, making them frustrating to use for non-English players. Yet in-game, we cannot simply select and copy text for translation. That leaves us with screenshots, photos, OCR, or guesswork.
So I created this mod with Qwen3.8-Max (hereafter referred to as **BLG**). Most translation mods to date have focused mainly on base-game text and official asset names, but **BLG can translate every piece of text you can see**. Whether it is a mod’s settings interface or an asset information panel, the mod will automatically call a translation engine and convert it into your target language. All you need to do is wait a few seconds.
## How to Use
**Subscribe to BLG → Open the BLG page in the game’s Options menu → Choose your target language and save → Select the translation scope → Select a translation engine → Turn on the master translation switch**
BLG currently supports translation into more than 50 languages.
Its translation scope includes base-game text, mod option pages and in-game panels, asset names and descriptions, and world-rendered text such as road names and district names. You are free to enable one or more of these categories.
For most users, Google Translate is usually sufficient. If you need stronger contextual understanding and more semantic accuracy, you can choose AI translation instead. BLG currently supports integration with 12 major free translation engines, as well as API access to mainstream paid AI models such as GPT and Claude. Of course, custom API endpoints are also supported.
After making your selections, be sure to test engine connectivity before enabling translation. During translation, an ellipsis (“···”) will appear at the end of a paragraph to indicate that the text is being translated or is waiting to be translated.
## Compatibility
I have tested BLG for compatibility with **I18N EVERYWHERE** and other localization mods that depend on it. If their target language matches BLG’s, BLG will not override the other localization mod. If the target languages differ, BLG will take precedence because it has the highest priority, and it will override them.
For example, if you subscribe to a Chinese localization mod, that mod will first replace the text with Chinese when you launch the game. Once BLG is enabled, it will detect that the text is already in Chinese and skip translation, so it will not overwrite it.
However, if your target language is set to Chinese and you have a Japanese localization mod subscribed, BLG will translate the Japanese text produced by that mod into Chinese again. How can you avoid this? Simply disable the conflicting parts of the translation scope.
For example, you could keep in-game road names and district names in Japanese, while letting BLG handle only out-of-game text such as asset names and mod interfaces.
I have also tested BLG with more than a dozen mainstream mods and have not encountered any issues so far. In theory, as long as a mod does not modify text in real time, there should be no conflict. If you do run into a serious issue, you can send your log to the discussion board or report it through Skyve.
## Additional Notes
* Text inside images, and text embedded in textures, cannot be translated, because those are pixels rather than strings. * Since the game’s built-in glyph set is incomplete, many less common languages would otherwise appear as squares after translation, so only the 50+ languages that display properly are currently retained. * For performance and technical reasons, I did not scan and translate every piece of text when entering the game. Instead, BLG uses lazy translation (real-time translation with real-time results). In testing, the impact on frame rate and simulation speed is almost negligible. * Do not worry about having to retranslate everything each time you restart the game. BLG caches translation results locally after the first translation. Unless you clear the cache or the source text changes, it will use the cached result afterward. * Your API key is stored locally only, and it will be sent only to the translation service you choose. * All translated text is generated by third-party translation APIs and is **not guaranteed to be perfectly accurate**. All rights to the original text remain with their respective authors.
## Donations
This is my first mod.
If you find it helpful, would you buy me a cup of coffee? ☕
# **拯救语言不通**
### V1.0稳定版发布啦！ 焕然一新！稳定版优化了很多地方，还新增了多个主流翻译引擎，大幅提升翻译速度，并且选项界面也得到了改造！
## 描述
从1代到2代，模组和资产的本地化翻译一直很依赖作者和社区贡献者。很多有趣的模组和资产，因为缺少本地化翻译，让非英语玩家在使用时很痛苦。但是在游戏内我们无法选中复制文本翻译，要么截图拍照识别，要么靠猜。
于是我用 Qwen3.8-Max 做了这个模组（以下简称 **BLG**，我也不知道为什么缩写刚好是这三个字母）。此前的大多数翻译模组基本都只涉及游戏本体文本和官方资产名称，而 **BLG 可以翻译你能看到的所有文字**。无论是模组选项界面，还是资产信息视图，模组都会自动调用翻译引擎翻译成目标语言，你要做的仅仅只是等待几秒钟。
## 使用方法
**订阅BLG→进入游戏的选项页面找到BLG→选择目标语言并保存→选择翻译范围→选择翻译引擎→启用翻译总开关**
目前支持 50 余种语言翻译。
BLG 的翻译范围包括游戏本体文本、模组选项页面及游戏内面板、资产名称及描述、游戏世界渲染文本（如道路名称、区域名称等），你可以自由启用其中的一项或多项。
翻译引擎通常google翻译就足够了，如果你对上下文理解有更高的语义要求，可以选择AI翻译。目前已接入12个主流的免费翻译引擎，以及GPT、Claude等主流AI收费模型的API接入。当然，本模组也支持自定义API接口。
选择完必须测试引擎连通性，没问题再启用翻译。翻译时，段落末尾会显示“···”，表示该文本正在翻译或等待翻译。
## 兼容性
我已经测试过 BLG 与 **I18N EVERYWHERE** 以及依赖它的本地化翻译模组的兼容性。如果它们的目标语言一致，BLG不会覆盖其它本地化模组；如果目标语言不一致，那么由于BLG的优先级是最高的，它就会覆盖。
举个例子：如果你订阅了中文本地化翻译模组，那么进入游戏时，本地化模组会先把文本替换成中文。启用 BLG 后，由于BLG检测到文本已经是中文，因此会直接跳过翻译，不会覆盖。
但是如果你目标语言选了中文，有订阅日文的本地化翻译模组，那么 BLG 就会把被替换的日文再次翻译成中文。怎么解决呢？关闭翻译范围中有冲突的部分。
例如，让游戏内的道路名称、区域名称等等都显示日文，而 BLG 只负责翻译资产名称、模组界面等游戏外的文本。
我还测试了主流的十几款模组，目前测试还未发现问题，理论上，只要不是实时修改文本的，都不会产生冲突。如果有严重问题，可以发送日志到讨论区，或上报skyve。
## 其它说明
* 图片中的文字、贴图上的文字无法翻译（因为它们是像素，而不是字符串）。 * 由于游戏内置字形并不完整，很多较冷门语言翻译后会直接显示为方块，因此目前仅保留了 50 余种能够正常显示的语言。 * 出于性能和一些技术上的考虑，我并没有在进入游戏时扫描并翻译所有文本，而是采用了懒翻译（实时翻译、实时生效）的方式。根据测试，对帧率和模拟速度的影响几乎可以忽略。 * 不用担心每次重启游戏都会重新翻译。BLG会在第一次翻译后将结果缓存在本地，除非你清除缓存，或者原文本有变动，否则后面都会直接调用缓存结果。 * 你的 API Key 仅保存在本地，并且只会发送给你所选择的翻译服务。 * 所有译文均由第三方翻译接口生成，**不保证绝对准确**。所有原文版权均归其原作者所有。
## 捐赠
这是我的第一个模组。
如果你觉得它对你有所帮助，可以请我喝一杯咖啡吗？☕
Publish.ChangeLog:
v1.0.3
- Added 8 free translation engines and merged them with the 4 that already existed: you now get 3 machine-translation engines that work out of the box, 4 that need a registered key, and 5 AI engines that need a key. - Added AI large-model API access billed by token usage, with 8 mainstream providers built in (GPT, DeepSeek, Claude and others) plus custom API endpoints. Token usage is counted and shown locally. - Added hotkey settings. - Reworked the settings UI: translation options, translation engines and everything else are now on separate tabs. - Reworked the translation mechanism and performance: "in-game overlay text" became "world-rendered text", which is now translated and refreshed automatically once you enter a save, with no manual step. Translating large amounts of text and multi-screen queued requests is also faster. - Reworked saving: every setting except the target language now saves in real time and takes effect immediately. - Rewrote descriptions, error messages and hints, and improved text display in several places. - Fixed the Google translation API endpoint. - Fixed known bugs, including dead endpoints being called over and over, and text getting translated again right after you clear the cache. - No longer conflicts with the Write Everywhere mod.
中文
- 新增 8 个免费翻译引擎，并整合此前已有的 4 个引擎；当前支持 3 个可直接使用的机翻、4 个需注册 Key 的机翻、5 个需注册 Key 的 AI 翻译。 - 新增 AI 大模型 API 接入，支持按 token 消耗进行翻译；内置 GPT、DeepSeek、Claude 等 8 家主流厂商，并支持自定义 API 接口，token 消耗将本地统计并显示。 - 新增快捷键设置。 - 优化设置界面，将翻译设置、翻译引擎及其他设置拆分为独立标签页。 - 优化翻译机制与性能，将“游戏内叠层文本”调整为“游戏世界渲染文本”，现在进入存档后自动翻译并刷新，减少手动操作。同时提升了大量文本及多屏队列请求场景下的翻译速度。 - 优化保存机制，除目标语言外，其余设置项现可实时保存并立即生效。 - 优化说明、报错、提醒等文本，并改善多处文字显示效果。 - 修复 Google 翻译 API 接口问题。 - 修复失效接口反复调用、清除缓存仍会自动翻译等已知 BUG。 - 现在不会再跟Write Everywhere模组发生冲突了。
